implementation_summary: Created comprehensive Effect.Stream-based streaming system for Codex integration: (1) makeStreamingChannel - creates streaming channel with controller for emit/abort operations. (2) Backpressure handling via bounded Queue with configurable buffer size (default 16). (3) Per-chunk timeout system: 30s warning via onWarning callback, 120s failure with StreamError. (4) Abort signal support with reason tracking and clean termination. (5) Chunk ordering guarantees with index tracking. (6) Timestamp tracking for each chunk. (7) fromProducer wrapper for converting producer functions to streams. (8) collectChunks utility for gathering stream results. (9) scoped variant with automatic abort on scope close. (10) Comprehensive test suite with 25+ test cases covering backpressure, timeouts, abort, ordering, concurrent access, and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria_met: Streaming responses are yielded as Effect.Stream chunks
Backpressure prevents memory buildup when consumer is slow (bounded queue)
Per-chunk timeout emits warning at 30 seconds, fails at 120 seconds
Abort signal cancels the upstream request and terminates the stream cleanly
Completed streams have all chunks in order with no duplicates (index tracking)
Non-streaming requests continue to work via the existing API (additive change)

Tests simulate slow producers, timeouts, and abort scenarios (25+ test cases)
